problem: Typed and raw entity ownership registration linearly scanned the destination owner vector before each insertion, creating cumulative quadratic duplicate-check work for large block lists.

details: Added an owner+entity-handle ordered membership set shared by typed and raw entity ownership registration.
Preserved historical per-owner duplicate behavior by including the BLOCK_RECORD handle in the key.
Bounded index cardinality at dwgSafety::MaxDwgReadObjectCount (1,000,000); retained vector publication is rolled back if membership insertion or vector append fails.
Updated compound rollback to erase indexed memberships alongside truncated modelspace, paperspace, and user-block entity-list tails, including removed post-checkpoint user blocks.
Added a generated focused selector and CTest for typed/raw duplicate rejection, per-owner scope, and rollback/retry without persistent DWG/DXF fixtures.
implementation.complexity: Duplicate lookup changes from linear owner-list scan to O(log N) ordered-set lookup. No timing benchmark or RSS bound is claimed.
implementation.wire_behavior: No serialized field, handle ordering, public API, or support claim changed.
